data.name: Alice
data.message: I'm heading to security for cameras.

I reported Bob’s body in Navigation. My route was Security -> Weapons -> back to Security -> Navigation. 

I saw Bob in Security around ticks 2-4. Diana entered Security from Navigation at tick 3, and Frank was also in Security around tick 4. Later I saw Alice in Security around tick 9. After that I went to Navigation and found Bob dead there.

I don’t have a hard accusation yet, but Bob must have gone from Security to Navigation sometime after I last saw him. Anyone who was around Navigation or came from that side should explain.

My route was Navigation -> Security -> Electrical -> Medbay. I came out of Navigation early and didn’t see a body there then. At tick 3 I was in Security with Bob, Charlie, and Frank; I saw Frank enter Security from Weapons at that time. Bob was definitely alive then.

After that I went to Electrical and saw Alice there around tick 5, then I ended in Medbay. I didn’t see Bob after Security, and I didn’t see anyone go into Navigation myself.

Charlie’s report mostly lines up with what I saw in Security. The kill had to be after tick 3 if Bob was alive with us there. Anyone who stayed around Security/Navigation after that or followed Bob toward Navigation needs to explain.

My route was Medbay -> Electrical -> Security -> Weapons.

I saw Diana enter Electrical from Security around tick 5, which matches her story. Later I saw Charlie enter Security from Weapons around tick 8, then leave Security toward Navigation around tick 9. I didn’t see Bob at all this round, and I never went into Navigation.

So from my view, Diana’s route checks out for tick 5, and Charlie’s movement into Navigation lines up with him reporting. I don’t have a hard sus yet. I’d like to hear from Frank especially, since both Charlie and Diana place Frank in Security early with Bob. Eve also needs to say where she was.

I don’t have much direct info, unfortunately. My route was Storage into Lower Engine, and I didn’t encounter anyone at all. I never went near Security or Navigation, and I never saw Bob this round.

From what’s been said, Diana and Alice seem to partially confirm each other around Electrical at tick 5. Charlie’s report path is also at least partly confirmed by Alice seeing him in Security around tick 8 and then heading toward Navigation.

The main missing piece for me is Frank. Multiple people place Frank in Security early with Bob, and we don’t know where he went after that. Since Bob was alive in Security around tick 3-4 and later dead in Navigation, anyone who stayed near Security/Navigation after that matters most.

I’d like to hear Frank’s full route before voting. Right now I’m most interested in Frank’s explanation, but I don’t have enough to hard accuse yet.

My route was Cafeteria -> Weapons -> Security, then I went out through Electrical/Medbay toward Storage. I ended in Storage doing cargo.

In Security early I saw Bob alive with Charlie and Diana there. I also saw Charlie leave Security toward Weapons around then, which matches him saying he went Weapons and came back later. I didn’t follow Bob and I didn’t go into Navigation, so I can’t speak to the body itself.

What stands out to me is Alice saw Charlie come back into Security around tick 8 and then go toward Navigation right before the report. That could just be a normal find, but it’s also the closest timing we have to the body being discovered. Diana/Alice seem to line up with each other in Electrical, and Eve was far away. I get why people are asking me because I was in Security early, but Bob was alive when I left that area. Charlie’s late Security -> Navigation timing is what I’d look at most.

I’ll push back on Frank a bit: Alice seeing me go Security -> Navigation right before the report is exactly because I found and reported the body there. If I were trying to hide something, I probably wouldn’t self-report in Navigation after being seen leaving Security.

The key facts from my side are still: Bob was alive in Security at ticks 2-4 with me, Diana, and Frank around. Diana is partly checked by Alice in Electrical. Alice saw me later in Security and can confirm my path to the report. Eve claims far away with no contact.

Frank is the least confirmed after being in Security with Bob early, and now he’s pointing at the reporter based only on timing. I’m most suspicious of Frank right now unless someone has stronger info.

I still think Frank is the main one who needs scrutiny here.

To restate my info: I started Navigation and left early, and there was no body there when I left. At tick 3 I was in Security with Bob, Charlie, and Frank, and Bob was alive. I specifically saw Frank enter Security from Weapons. Then I went Security -> Electrical -> Medbay, and Alice saw me in Electrical around tick 5, which matches both our stories.

Frank says he left Security through Electrical/Medbay toward Storage, but I didn’t see him in Electrical when I was there, and Alice only saw me there too. Maybe timing could explain it, but it’s the weakest route right now.

Charlie’s timing is close to the report, but Alice seeing him go toward Navigation also fits him finding the body. Frank was with Bob early, is less confirmed afterward, and is now pushing the reporter. My vote is likely Frank unless someone has a stronger contradiction.

Just to clarify my info again: I went Medbay -> Electrical -> Security -> Weapons. I saw Diana enter Electrical from Security around tick 5, so her route checks out to me. I did not see Frank come through Electrical or Medbay while I was there, though timing could explain that.

Then in Security around tick 8 I saw Charlie enter from Weapons, and at tick 9 I saw him leave Security toward Navigation. That does put Charlie close to the report, but it also matches him finding the body and reporting it. I didn’t see Bob at all and I never went into Navigation.

Right now I agree Frank has the weakest follow-up after being in Security early with Bob. He was placed near Bob while Bob was alive, and his claimed path isn’t confirmed by me or Diana. I’m leaning Frank unless there’s a stronger contradiction.

I still don’t have any direct sightings to add — my route was Storage -> Lower Engine, and I didn’t see anyone or any bodies. I never went near Security or Navigation, so I can’t personally clear or accuse anyone from vision.

Based on everyone else’s info, I think Diana and Alice line up pretty well around Electrical, and Alice also confirms Charlie’s movement toward Navigation right before the report. That could be a self-report, but it also fits a normal body find.

Frank’s route is the weakest to me: he was in Security early when Bob was alive, then claims he went through Electrical/Medbay toward Storage, but neither Diana nor Alice saw him passing through that area. Maybe timing explains it, but compared to everyone else, he’s the least confirmed and was near Bob earlier.

So unless Frank has something stronger or the last speaker catches a contradiction, I’m leaning Frank.

I need to correct something because I think my first route was too shorthand and it’s making me look worse than it should. I did Cafeteria -> Weapons -> Security early, saw Bob alive in Security with Charlie/Diana there, then I left that side and ended up Storage for cargo. I was not sitting in Security/Navigation after Bob left.

The reason Alice/Diana didn’t see me in Electrical is probably timing/path — I wasn’t with them when they were crossing there. I didn’t see either of them later either, so that lines up as a timing gap, not proof I killed Bob.

What still bothers me is Charlie is the one confirmed going Security -> Navigation right before the report. I get that reporters can be innocent, but “I reported so I’m clear” isn’t enough. He had the exact late path to the body, and now the whole push is on me because I was in Security early when Bob was alive — but multiple people were there then. Bob did not die at tick 3-4 in front of us.

If you vote me here, you’re voting on “Frank was nearby early” while ignoring “Charlie was the one seen going toward the body right before it was reported.” I think this is a bad tunnel. I’d vote Charlie before voting me.
